sentences: Traders moved $869 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-07-13, across 24.1 million individual trades. with 24,788 wallets placing their first-ever bet. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 80% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 20%.
The most-traded market was "Will Spain win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?", pulling in $22 million of volume.
Probability weighting among human traders was near rational this week (parameter 1.03).
